title: A plain feedback message marked Question waits for a reply HQ cannot send
what: When a feedback message that did not come through the help box is marked Question, Needs you counts it as a help question waiting for your reply, but its card in HQ has no reply box. It can never be answered from HQ and stays on the list until it is marked done.
expected: Every message Needs you calls waiting for a reply can be answered from HQ, or HQ says plainly that this one cannot be answered and how to reach the person instead.
who: members and gyms who sent feedback, and the owner
how_often: every plain feedback message marked Question
fix_line: Leave plain feedback out of the waiting-for-reply count, or show a clear line on the card saying it cannot be answered in the app

title: HQ tells you the wrong place for the gym’s own support switch
what: The support access card says the gym opens access from Settings, Your data. The admin app moved that card to Help and feedback, and its own What’s new says so. On a call you would send the owner to the wrong screen.
expected: HQ names the screen where the switch really is: Help and feedback.
who: owner, gym owners on a support call
how_often: every time support is asked for
fix_line: Change the words to say Help and feedback

title: The welcome message to a new gym owner gives no address for the admin app
what: The message HQ makes for a new or locked-out owner says to open the MettleUp admin app and type the code, but has no link or web address. A new owner does not know where that app is, and the code stops working after 30 minutes.
expected: The message carries the admin app’s address so the owner can tap it and sign in before the code runs out.
how_often: every new gym and every sign-in reset
fix_line: Add the admin app address to the message

title: HQ warns only about the logs key; every other key can stop working without a word
what: HQ shows a warning when the Supabase logs key fails or is near its end. When the phone pop-up key, the admin app alert key or the Cloudflare usage key is missing or refused, the server only writes a hidden log line, and the System page says errors and outages are not connected yet. Member reply pop-ups or gym alerts could stop for weeks without you knowing.
expected: Each key HQ relies on shows on the System page as working, missing or refused, and a refused key shows in Needs you.
who: owner, members waiting for replies, gyms waiting for alerts
how_often: whenever a key ends or is revoked
fix_line: Record each key’s last result and show it on the System page and in Needs you

title: Some HQ steps end in tell Claude, with no written steps for anyone else
what: Signing a gym out everywhere can say the gym has an old browser key and to tell Claude. Renewing the logs key ends with tell Claude its end date. Nothing in HQ says what Claude then does, so if Claude is not at hand the job cannot be finished.
expected: Each step HQ asks for is something you can finish yourself in HQ, or links to written steps.
how_often: rare: an old browser key, or once a year for the logs key
fix_line: Give the key end date a box in HQ and the old browser key its own remove button

title: Needs you says nothing when the payments to confirm cannot be counted
what: If the count of payments waiting to be confirmed, or of online payments to check, cannot be read, Needs you simply leaves the line out. The could-not-count warning looks only at leads, feedback, help questions and new gyms. You may think no gym is waiting for its plan while one is.
expected: A payment count that could not be read shows the same could-not-count warning.
fix_line: Tell a failed payment read apart from switched off and show the warning for it

title: Complaints and refund requests by email or phone have no place in HQ
what: The contact page promises to confirm a complaint within 48 hours and settle it within a month, and asks people to write about payments and refunds. HQ can write down only delete requests that came by email or phone. Complaints, refund asks and plan changes by email have no list and no clock, so a missed one is not noticed.
expected: HQ has one place to write down a request that came by email or phone, with its promised deadline counted in Needs you.
who: gym owners and members who email or call
how_often: every complaint or refund ask by email or phone
fix_line: Let the delete request list also take complaints, refunds and plan changes, each with its deadline

title: Nothing reaches you about a new lead or help question unless HQ is open
what: HQ beeps and pops up only while it is open in a tab, and says so: when HQ is closed, no alert comes to your phone. The website tells a gym we will call you soon and the apps say we reply as soon as we can, so a lead or a question can wait days unseen.
expected: A new lead or a help question waiting for a reply reaches your phone even when HQ is closed, for example a daily summary or a phone pop-up.
who: owner, gyms asking for a demo, people asking for help
how_often: every day HQ is not opened
fix_line: Send a phone pop-up or a daily summary for new leads and waiting questions
